handover_protocol.new_chat_start: Read CURRENT first, then fresh-reconcile live GitHub main, open PRs, relevant branches and CI before acting. Live GitHub outranks this snapshot.

lane.name: Culinary App / Culinary Lab — Corpus Scale / 100k Readiness with additive YouTube Culinary Discovery child programme
lane.rule: Do not perform ordinary Culinary Brain / Knowledge Core implementation from this lane.
lane.knowledge_core_boundary: Knowledge Core remains read-only/reconciliation from this lane and must never become a private browser/runtime dependency.
lane.nutrition_boundary: Nutrition remains an independent resumable lane and must not be overwritten or weakened by corpus-scale or YouTube-discovery work.

operating_contract.autonomy: Proceed autonomously through technically resolvable repository work after fresh reconciliation and after any explicit human-only dependency is satisfied.
operating_contract.user_facing_rule: No routine narration. Speak only for a genuine human/security/cost/policy gate, unrecoverable error, terminal material result, or continuation boundary.
operating_contract.fresh_reconciliation: Before every meaningful write or merge, fresh-reconcile main, open PRs, relevant branches, changed files, CI and concurrent work.
operating_contract.actions_authority: Normal repository CI, browser acceptance, roadmap-required benchmark workflows, path-scoped validation and technically necessary ordinary reruns are standing-preauthorized by AGENTS.md. Do not reintroduce per-run approval gates.
operating_contract.cost_boundary: No paid Cloudflare plan, paid API, paid corpus licence or other new recurring infrastructure cost is authorized. A materially abnormal CI loop or runaway Actions consumption is a cost gate; ordinary expected CI is not.
operating_contract.continuation_rule: At a continuation boundary rotate PREVIOUS/CURRENT in GitHub and keep CURRENT sufficient for a new chat to resume without copy-paste.

youtube_culinary_discovery.purpose: Use a distinct YouTube Data API client as a transient high-throughput culinary discovery/navigation layer feeding independently reviewed World Recipe Atlas and app corpus candidates; never treat raw YouTube results as permanent recipes.
youtube_culinary_discovery.separation: Distinct API client/use case from youtube-blue-lagoon-lab; no credential, quota, planner-state or evidence sharing.
youtube_culinary_discovery.secret_rule: Never commit or paste the key into chat, issues, commits, repository files or handovers.
youtube_culinary_discovery.storage_rule: Raw YouTube API metadata is transient only and must not enter immutable Git history; architectural default TTL 7 days, hard maximum 30 days under the policy rechecked on 2026-09-05.
youtube_culinary_discovery.derived_metrics_rule: Do not create durable YouTube-derived creator/channel quality, authenticity, engagement or culinary scores; independent non-YouTube evidence is required for durable promotion handoffs unless a future audited permission path explicitly changes policy authority.
youtube_culinary_discovery.public_runtime_rule: YT-CUL discovery creates no public-runtime authority and does not change the browser app automatically.

owner_actions: Create or connect a Cloudflare Pages project to DataRaul/culinary-recommender-app.
Create one Cloudflare R2 Standard bucket for the pilot corpus.
Enable Cloudflare Zero Trust / Access on the protected production hostname.
Enable One-time PIN and an exact-email allow policy only.
Do not add Everyone, wildcard/broad email-domain or OTP-only Include rules.
Do not enable a paid Workers, Access or R2 plan and do not create D1.
Do not commit credentials, tokens, account IDs or invited email addresses to the repository.

youtube.note: Any future paid quota/infrastructure request, policy/audit requirement or security/access change remains a genuine gate.

youtube_culinary_discovery.name: YT_CUL_3_ONE_DAY_BOUNDED_DISCOVERY_PILOT
instructions: Fresh-recheck current YouTube policy and actual project quota before the governed quota day.
Preserve the verified 100/day Search Queries limit unless Cloud Console shows a changed assigned limit.
Preserve at least five Search calls as reserve; do not plan more than 95 acquisition calls under the current 100/day limit.
Measure calls -> transient candidates -> independently reviewed sources -> Atlas promotions -> app handoffs -> actual public admissions.
Never count gross YouTube results as recipes acquired.
Keep raw YouTube API metadata transient only and preserve the seven-day default / thirty-day hard maximum cache policy.
Do not create YouTube-derived creator/authenticity/engagement quality scores.
Keep Blue Lagoon credentials, quota, planner state and evidence isolated.
Terminate the pilot into one of the four preregistered YT-CUL-3 terminal classifications before any scale decision.
